instruction: Put the blue pen in the green pen case.

attempts.code:
candidates = grasp_candidates("blue_pen")
best_candidate = None
best_score = -1
for c in candidates:
    if c["source"] == "geometry" and abs(c["yaw"] - (-1.335)) < 0.1 and c["fits_open_fingers"]:
        if c["score"] > best_score:
            best_score = c["score"]
            best_candidate = c

if best_candidate is None:
    best_candidate = candidates[0]

grasp(best_candidate)
wait(10)

spots = free_spots("green_case", "blue_pen")
best_spot = None
best_clearance = -1
for spot in spots["spots"]:
    if abs(spot["object_long_axis_yaw"] - spots["long_axis_yaw"]) < 0.1:
        if spot["clearance"] > best_clearance:
            best_clearance = spot["clearance"]
            best_spot = spot

if best_spot is None:
    best_spot = spots["spots"][0]

carry_to(best_spot["x"], best_spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=best_spot["object_long_axis_yaw"])
wait(10)
lower_until_contact()
wait(10)
open_gripper()
wait(10)
retreat(0.12)
wait(10)
check("blue_pen", "green_case")
